# A068 — Color of root label not exported through XCAF

- OCCT MANTIS#0030856
- OCCT MANTIS#0032977

## Description

A document holds a colour assigned to the root XCAF label (the document's overall appearance). Writer iterates child labels but never visits the root, so colour records on the root are lost on round-trip.

## Reproducer recipe

XCAF document with a colour tagged at root level (no parts, just root colour). Write to STEP and re-read; root colour is default.

## Expected kernel behavior

writer iterates root + descendants when emitting style records; root-level styles must round-trip.
